_README: Every value on this site that changes between countries lives here.
Anything marked NEEDS-CONFIRMATION is a commercial or factual decision
that is yours to make - I will not guess at prices, coverage or numbers.
localise.sh reads this file and rewrites the site copy in sites/sudan/.

country.name: Sudan
country._note_languages: Arabic is the working language for most of Sudan. The site is English-only today - see docs for the RTL question.

currency._question: Are the sales-team prices (142, 218, 366, 513, 814) in USD, or SDG? The site quotes prices in 158 places and must not be ambiguous.

systems._note_crm: Live and holding a valid certificate as of today.
systems._question_portal: South Sudan uses portal.dishnetss.com, referenced 127 times. Does Sudan get its own customer portal, share the existing one, or is that section removed for launch?

contact._note_sales: The number dishnet_sales is paired to. Confirm this is the number Sudan customers should see - it carries a +211 prefix, which reads as South Sudan.
contact._question: South Sudan shows a Juba office on Airport Road, Kololo, open 8am-8pm daily. What is the Sudan equivalent, and is there a physical office customers can visit?

coverage._question: Which Sudanese cities and states does DishNet actually serve? Do not assume Khartoum - the site makes coverage claims in 222 places and a wrong claim generates support tickets and refunds. List only where you can genuinely install.

starlink._source: Sales team spreadsheet, 25 Aug 2026. Customer-facing column only.
starlink._never_publish: Starlink subscription cost, terminal charge, and DishNet selling price are internal margin data. They must not appear on the site or reach the AI.

terminal_charge._question: Your sheet folds 20 into the monthly total. Is it monthly (like Starlink's own terminal access fee) or a one-off? If one-off it must not sit inside a monthly price, and the customer has to be told separately.

starlink.throttle_after_cap: 1 Mbps down / 500 Kbps up until the next month
starlink._question_hardware: The site sells four Starlink kits (Mini, V4, Flat High Performance, Standard Actuated) with South Sudan prices. What are the Sudan prices, and which kits do you actually stock?

fiber._question: fiber.html is 49 KB of South Sudan fibre content with a named supplier and per-plan pricing. Does DishNet sell fibre in Sudan at all? If not, the page should be removed rather than left with wrong claims.

lte._question: Same question for LTE/SIM. The South Sudan site sells Silver/Gold/Platinum/Diamond SIM plans.

demo_sites._question: demo/ is 229 pages of NGO, embassy and UN demo dashboards using South Sudan state codes - Jonglei, Lakes, Unity, Upper Nile, Warrap, the Equatorias. For Sudan they are either rebuilt with Sudanese states, kept as a generic capability demo, or dropped. They are also the bulk of the site's file count.

testimonials._question: testimonials.html quotes named South Sudan customers. Using those to sell in Sudan would be misleading. Remove until you have Sudanese ones?

blog._note: Three posts, all South Sudan specific, including one titled 'Starlink in South Sudan'. Rewrite or drop.

performance._note: Sudan connectivity is the design constraint, so these are not cosmetic.
performance._action_fonts: Self-host the two font families. 536 external references means every page waits on fonts.googleapis.com before it renders.
performance._action_images: All six images are hotlinked from dishnetafrica.com and portal.dishnetss.com. Copy them into the Sudan site so it does not depend on South Sudan infrastructure being up.
